main.description: A skill an agent keeps in a memory space for every agent in it: instructions for a kind of work, in the Agent Skills format (a SKILL.md and the files beside it). The record key is the skill's name. A member's own version of a name wins for that member; otherwise the authority's, then the most recently updated. Agents update skills in place when they learn a step was wrong.

name.description: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, with no leading, trailing or doubled hyphen. The same as the record key.

description.description: What the skill does and when to use it. Agents see only this until they load the skill.

instructions.description: The body of SKILL.md, after its frontmatter: Markdown instructions.

files.description: Files beside SKILL.md (scripts, references, templates), as text.

disableModelInvocation.description: Load the skill only when a person asks for it by name, never on the agent's own judgment.

note.description: What the latest update changed and why.

path.description: Relative to the skill's directory, with forward slashes. No '..', no leading '/', and not SKILL.md.
